work.description: The act raises the Good Books confraternity of Saint-Paul, Bordeaux, to an archconfraternity with power of aggregation. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF9451; own dating clause LF9532–9535 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die decima sexta septembris millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo primo, pontificatus Nostri anno primo... Own provenance note LF9538 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
